policy_resolution: defaults then top-level window fields then policy_overrides; every scenario_defaults key is overridable including contagion_seed_z contagion_damp quarantine_damp escalate_z min_emit_contribution

rules.z: HIGH (obs-mean)/std; LOW (mean-obs)/std; std<=0 equal=>0 else sentinel; deviate iff round4(z)>z_threshold
rules.verdict: CLEAN if no deviations; else WATCH if conf<floor; else ALERT if count>=2 or role in server|dns|dc or max_z>=escalate_z else WATCH
rules.suppress: if beacon_interval and unique_peers both deviate drop unique_peers
rules.graphs: peers[] => bidir cost-1 contagion edges AND undirected cluster edges among FINAL ALERT hosts only (after quarantine+contagion); peer_links => directed contagion only; clusters never use peer_links; CLEAN and WATCH never become cluster members or inflate organic_count
rules.quarantine_first: before contagion, WATCH with >=quarantine_min provisional ALERT sources at direct cost<=quarantine_cost => ALERT promote_kind=quarantine hops=1
rules.contagion: iterative direct edges with cost < contagion_max_cost (half-open); CLEAN never relays; quarantine ALERTs do not spread; seeds need max_z>=contagion_seed_z
rules.hops: after contagion membership stabilizes, set seed hops=0 then for at most |hosts| passes set each contagion host hops=max(spreader.hops+1) over qualifying direct edges (MAXIMUM hops not minimum)
rules.boost: non-promoted ALERT hosts: boost=1.0+0.15*organic_count where organic_count=number of ALERT members in the peer component with empty promote_kind (exclude contagion/quarantine promoted). clusters[].size is full final-ALERT member count including promoted. Promoted hosts always boost=1.0. Unclustered boost=1.0. CLEAN/WATCH never join clusters
rules.severity: 1.0+0.05*count of ALL surviving deviations with z>=5 (not only emitted factors)
rules.priority: stage1=round4(conf*role); stage2=round4(stage1*severity); stage3=round4(stage2*boost); priority=round4(stage3*damp) where damp=contagion_damp**hops or quarantine_damp or 1
rules.risk_high: HIGH iff verdict==ALERT AND confidence>=0.8 AND max surviving z>=5
rules.factors_sort: catalog index asc then contribution desc
rules.invest_sort: priority desc, risk HIGH<MEDIUM<LOW, host_id asc
rules.encoding: compact JSON trailing newline; empty arrays not null; catalog window order; hosts by host_id
rules.risk_medium: MEDIUM iff not HIGH and confidence>=confidence_floor
rules.risk_low: LOW otherwise (including WATCH/ALERT with conf below floor)
rules.investigations: emit exactly one investigation for every host with final verdict WATCH or ALERT; never emit for CLEAN
